message: 真実は闇の中

name: Eddie
message: 「So what are you gonna do, anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do about what?」

name: Eddie
message: 「About a dance partner, man」
Right now, the one thing on everyone's mind at school is the Holy Night Festival dance party.

name: Eddie
message: 「Well? Who are you planning to dance with?」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't really thought about it」

name: Eddie
message: 「Come on, it's a huge event--the perfect chance, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but I've never even danced before」

name: Eddie
message: 「I haven't either. Hey, don't sweat the small stuff like that. What matters is who you wanna dance with」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Is that how it works?」

name: Eddie
message: 「You really are a total airhead, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「How rude」

name: Eddie
message: 「Never mind that--come on, spill it. There's gotta be some girl you actually want to dance with, right?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Hey, I won't tell a soul, so just let me in on it, c'mon」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not really interested in that sort of thing」

name: Eddie
message: 「Whoa, hold on, 'not interested'...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Or rather... there's something I've been thinking about...」
I dropped out of school.
In the end, there was no point in me staying at that school...
With that thought, I holed up at home and decided to go back to living a quiet, peaceful life--just the three of us, with Paqy and Sasami.
Still, I suppose it couldn't be helped.
Re-Crea is still going on. Then again, this is a Re-Crea that struck after more than twenty years. It probably won't end so easily.
There are plenty of people who worry about Ryuusei Town and are willing to fight for it. Maybe it's better to leave the rest to spirited folks like them.
There's no need for me to push myself.
That's fine by me...
And right then, I had just come back from tending to the crops in the field, same as always.

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn!!」
Nanaka came running over, pale-faced.

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong……?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's bad…… It's really bad!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-The school……!!」
